## Overview

- **Name**: Web (SPA Client Framework)
- **Description**: Odoo 18.0 web client framework; provides single-page application shell, session management, action dispatcher, view layers (form/list/kanban/calendar/pivot/graph), OWL component framework integration, and frontend asset bundling
- **Location**: addons/web (root files only) — 2 root files (60 total in directory tree)
- **Language**: Python (Odoo ORM backend) + JavaScript (OWL/frontend)
- **Purpose**: Core web client framework; bridges Python ORM to frontend SPA via action system, search/read/write RPC, view rendering, and user session lifecycle

## Key Models & Extensions

**Core Web Models:**
- `ir.http` — HTTP request routing, session creation, web client initialization
- `ir.ui.view` — Form, list, kanban, calendar, pivot, graph view definitions (templates + Python processing)
- `ir.ui.menu` — Menu tree structure (parent-child hierarchy, action links, icons)
- `res.users` — User account with web preferences (theme, language, timezone)
- `res.config.settings` — Admin settings form for system configuration

**Supporting Models:**
- `ir.model` — Model registry and field metadata (used by view layer for validation/formatting)
- `ir.attachment` — File upload/storage (integrated with forms and reports)
- `ir.actions.*` — Action dispatcher (window actions, server actions, reports, client-side actions)
- `base.document_layout` — Report layout templates (headers, footers, company branding)

## Asset Bundles

Web module defines the primary frontend asset bundles that other modules extend:

**Main Bundles:**
- `web.assets_backend` — Core web client (OWL, views, search, webclient, navbar, forms) — loaded on login
- `web.assets_backend_lazy` — Lazy-loaded features (graph, pivot views) loaded on demand
- `web.assets_frontend` — Portal/public frontend (fields, widgets, public portal UI)
- `web.assets_frontend_lazy` — Lazy-loaded portal features
- `web.assets_web` — Backend + main.js + start.js (auto-bootstrap)
- `web.assets_web_print` — Print-specific CSS and variables (invoice, report rendering)
- `web.assets_web_dark` — Dark mode stylesheet overrides

**Test Bundles:**
- `web.assets_tests` — Legacy tour tests
- `web.assets_unit_tests` — Modern unit test suite (Hoot framework)
- `web.assets_unit_tests_setup` — Test environment bootstrap (module loader, test framework, helpers)
- `web.tests_assets` — QUnit legacy tests

**Library Bundles:**
- `web._assets_core` — Module loader, OWL, Luxon, core services (no views/controllers)
- `web._assets_bootstrap` — Bootstrap CSS framework integration
- `web._assets_helpers` — SCSS helpers, mixins, variables
- `web.ace_lib` — Ace code editor (for JavaScript, XML, Python, QWeb modes)
- `web.chartjs_lib`, `web.fullcalendar_lib` — Third-party charting/calendar (lazy-loaded)

**Report Bundles:**
- `web.report_assets_common` — Shared report rendering (Bootstrap, DOMpurify, fonts, layout styles)
- `web.report_assets_pdf` — PDF reset/normalization

## Frontend Asset Structure

Backend assets include:

- **JavaScript**:
  - `module_loader.js` — Odoo module system (define/require)
  - `env.js`, `session.js` — Shared context and user session
  - `src/core/**` — Services, utilities, hooks, translations
  - `src/views/**` — Form, List, Kanban, Calendar, Pivot, Graph view implementations
  - `src/webclient/**` — Navbar, action manager, menu, settings panel, reports

- **Stylesheets (SCSS)**:
  - `pre_variables.scss`, `primary_variables.scss` — CSS variables (colors, spacing, fonts)
  - `bootstrap_*.scss` — Bootstrap overrides and customizations
  - `ui.scss` — Odoo UI component styles
  - Per-view SCSS (forms, lists, kanban, etc.)

- **OWL Components**:
  - Form, List, Kanban, Calendar, Pivot, Graph renderers (in `src/views/`)
  - Webclient chrome (navbar, sidebar, action panel)
  - Field widgets (text, selection, many2one, one2many, many2many, etc.)

## Data Files (XML)

- `security/ir.model.access.csv` — Model-level access control rules

- `views/report_templates.xml` — Report rendering wrapper

## Key Controller Endpoints

Root-level action dispatcher and data APIs (detailed in `controllers/` subdirectory):

- **Session**: `/web/session/info` — User context, company, menu tree
- **Actions**: `/web/action/load` — Load and render client/window/server actions
- **Data**: `/web/dataset/{read,search,write,unlink,call_kw}` — ORM operations via RPC
- **Views**: `/web/view/{fields_view_get}` — Load view definitions + processed fields
- **Domain**: `/web/dataset/call_kw/evaluate_domain` — Evaluate domain filters
- **Reporting**: `/web/report/{print,download}` — Render/output reports
- **Binary**: `/web/binary/{image,download}` — File downloads, image serving
- **Search**: `/web/dataset/search_read` — List view combined search+read
- **Pivot/Graph**: `/web/dataset/call_kw` → compute pivot/graph data

**via ir.config.parameter:**

## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Mandatory infrastructure module**: Web is auto-installed on every Odoo instance; provides the SPA shell and all view rendering. Always present at Container and Context levels.
- **Framework-agnostic views**: Form/List/Kanban/Calendar/Pivot/Graph renderers are generic — each business module (CRM, HR, Projects) reuses them by defining XML view metadata.
- **Asset extension pattern**: Other modules extend `web.assets_backend` and `web.assets_frontend` to inject their own JavaScript/CSS. The bundler includes these assets in order of dependency.
- **Session-critical**: `ir.http` and session controller are the entry point for all SPA navigation. Any user/auth changes flow through web model extensions.
- **Boundary code**: Controllers mediate between frontend RPC calls and Python ORM; models extend Odoo core to add web-specific persistence (user preferences, menu customization).
- **Report rendering**: Bridges `ir.actions.report` (ORM) to frontend report viewer; uses shared Jinja2 + HTML/CSS rendering pipeline.
